name: LGM
description: Run LinkedIn and email outreach from Claude: build audiences, write campaigns, handle replies and measure pipeline with La Growth Machine.
long_description:
La Growth Machine (LGM) is a multichannel sales outreach platform for B2B teams. This extension gives Claude live access to your LGM workspace: build audiences from LinkedIn and Sales Navigator searches, write and edit campaign sequences, handle LinkedIn and email replies from the inbox, and measure which campaigns turn into replies, meetings and pipeline. Read tools run without confirmation; sending a message, editing a campaign or spending credits always asks first.

Usage analytics: each tool call sends a single first-party analytics event (the event name and the tool name only, no conversation content, no lead or message data) to La Growth Machine's own API at https://apiv2.lagrowthmachine.com/flow/tracking/mcp, authenticated with the same API key you provide. This is opt-out: enable the "Disable usage analytics" toggle (or set LGM_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true) to stop all analytics requests. See the README and privacy policy for details.

api_key.title: LGM API Key
api_key.description: Your La Growth Machine API key

disable_telemetry.title: Disable usage analytics
disable_telemetry.description: When enabled, the server sends no analytics events. By default each tool call sends one first-party event (event name + tool name only, no conversation content) to La Growth Machine's API.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: List all campaigns with filters (status, search) and pagination.

tools.name: list_public_campaigns
tools.description: List ready-made campaigns to copy: 'catalog' strategy templates (sequence architectures) and 'creators' use-case templates (example messaging). type=recommended returns a curated shortlist; an id passed to duplicate_campaign creates the user's copy.

tools.name: get_campaign_stats
tools.description: Get detailed statistics for a campaign (acceptance rate, reply rate, conversions).

tools.name: get_audience_leads
tools.description: List leads in an audience with the full lead record: identity & contact fields plus location, industry, shortBio, companyUrl, gender, twitter, persoEmail, relationsCount, enrichStatus, emailStatus, emailFoundBy, signal, crm_id, audience names and customAttribute1-20.

tools.name: get_lead_logs
tools.description: Get activity logs for a lead (emails, LinkedIn messages, connection requests).

tools.name: get_lead_conversations
tools.description: Get all conversations with a lead across channels (LinkedIn, email).

tools.name: get_conversation_messages
tools.description: Get all messages in a conversation with content and timestamps.

tools.name: get_campaign_messages
tools.description: Get message templates for a campaign with HTML content and sequence order.

tools.name: duplicate_campaign
tools.description: Duplicate a campaign with its sequence and step templates into a new draft campaign.

tools.name: edit_campaign_message
tools.description: Replace the content (and email subject) of a campaign step's existing message.

tools.name: get_campaign_steps
tools.description: List a campaign's message steps with stepId, channel, order, and whether a message is already attached.

tools.name: add_campaign_step_message
tools.description: Create a message and link it to an empty campaign step (stepId from get_campaign_steps).

tools.name: rename_campaign
tools.description: Rename a campaign (name must be unique across your campaigns).

tools.name: set_campaign_audience
tools.description: Assign or change the audience of a not-yet-started campaign (audienceId from list_audiences).

tools.name: set_campaign_identity
tools.description: Change the identity (LinkedIn account and email sender) of a not-yet-launched campaign; it then sends from every connected email address of that identity (identityId from list_identities).

tools.name: set_campaign_setting
tools.description: Enable or disable one boolean campaign setting: autoEnrich, outOfOffice, skipAlreadyContacted or ignoreEmojiOnlyReplies (the last two require a READY or PAUSED campaign).

tools.name: set_campaign_crm_sync
tools.description: Enable or disable CRM sync (HubSpot and/or Pipedrive) on a paused campaign; requires the CRM plan permission.

tools.name: pause_campaign
tools.description: Pause a RUNNING campaign (its leads' pending actions are put on hold until resumed); edits made while paused are not retroactive.

tools.name: resume_campaign
tools.description: Resume a PAUSED campaign (leads pick up their sequence where they stopped); subject to plan limits.

tools.name: launch_campaign
tools.description: Launch a READY campaign that has never been launched: starts real outreach to its audience; refused with the reasons when an audience, a step's content, a sender email address or a LinkedIn connection is missing, or a plan limit is reached.

tools.name: get_audience
tools.description: Get detailed audience info (name, description, size, type, import status).

tools.name: save_identity_preference
tools.description: Save a preference for an identity to personalize AI-generated content.

tools.name: create_audience_from_linkedin_url
tools.description: Create or populate an audience from a LinkedIn search, Sales Navigator search, LinkedIn post URL, or LinkedIn event URL (imports attendees — identity must be registered to the event).

tools.name: list_audiences
tools.description: List every audience of the workspace with id, name, and leadsCount. Use to resolve an audienceId by name — including right after create_audience_from_linkedin_url.

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Return the credit balance for the authenticated account (total + perishable). Check before spending or on user demand ("combien de crédits ?").

tools.name: enrich_lead
tools.description: Enrich a lead's pro email, phone number (PHONE_ENRICH, needs leadId) and/or LinkedIn profile fields. Spends credits. Two-step lockstep: preview (confirm=false) → surface cost → confirm=true + acknowledgedCostCredits=exact-preview-value.

tools.name: get_enrich_result
tools.description: Poll the result of an enrichment request created via enrich_lead — returns status and, once completed, the enriched data (proEmail, phone, etc.).

tools.name: list_identities
tools.description: List all connected identities (LinkedIn / email) for the authenticated user.

tools.name: create_lead
tools.description: Create a lead — or update it in place (upsert). Attach it to an audience, set profile fields, write the lead's note, and use the 20 custom-attribute slots for personalization notes.

tools.name: get_conversations_to_reply
tools.description: List inbox conversations waiting for the user's reply (lead spoke last, thread open).

tools.name: get_unread_conversations
tools.description: List unread inbox conversations, newest first.

tools.name: get_favourite_conversations
tools.description: List favourited / starred conversations, optionally only those where the lead replied.

tools.name: search_conversations
tools.description: Search and filter the whole conversation inbox by text, identity, campaign, audience, channel, status, dates and flags.

tools.name: snooze_conversation
tools.description: Snooze a conversation until a later time, hiding it from the active inbox.

tools.name: unsnooze_conversation
tools.description: Un-snooze a conversation, bringing it back into the active inbox.

tools.name: archive_conversation
tools.description: Archive a conversation, removing it from the active inbox.

tools.name: unarchive_conversation
tools.description: Restore an archived conversation back to the active inbox.

tools.name: list_members
tools.description: List the members (users) of the account — needed to pick a memberId for sending LinkedIn messages.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List the workspaces the authenticated user can act in — returns multiWorkspace and each workspace's id, name, plan, and which is current; only pass workspaceId to other tools when multiWorkspace is true.

tools.name: send_linkedin_message
tools.description: Send a LinkedIn text or voice message to a lead from a connected identity.

tools.name: send_email_message
tools.description: Send an email to a lead from a connected email identity (new thread or reply).

tools.name: enrich_linkedin_post
tools.description: Fetch a public LinkedIn post's text, author, and engagement metrics from its URL. Spends 1 credit per call, after an explicit cost confirmation.

tools.name: ask_your_outbound
tools.description: Run a read-only BigQuery SELECT over the workspace's activity logs (campaign actions, replies, opens, clicks, bounces). Call get_bigquery_logs_guide once first for the schema and verified metric definitions.

tools.name: get_bigquery_logs_guide
tools.description: Return the full BigQuery logs guide: schema, verified metric definitions, and example queries. Read it before writing analytics with ask_your_outbound.

tools.name: set_lead_status
tools.description: Set a lead's qualification tag in one campaign (Interested, Not interested, Wrong target, Call booked). Stops the lead's sequence in that campaign if it is still running.

tools.name: list_manual_tasks
tools.description: List the manual tasks waiting for you, oldest first: calls to make and custom messages to write, each with its lead (name, company, phone, email, LinkedIn URL), campaign and message channel.

tools.name: complete_call_task
tools.description: Complete a call task: decisive with the lead's answer (Interested, Call booked, Not interested, Wrong target) stops the lead's sequence; unreachable lets it continue.

tools.name: complete_message_task
tools.description: Complete a custom-message task with your personalised LinkedIn or email message; the campaign then sends it to the lead.

tools.name: call_api_read
tools.description: Read any GET endpoint of the documented LGM public API that no dedicated tool covers (a route a dedicated tool covers first points to that tool, confirm=true calls it anyway). Restricted to the documented catalogue.

tools.name: call_api_write
tools.description: Call any POST or DELETE endpoint of the documented LGM public API that no dedicated tool covers (a route a dedicated tool covers first points to that tool, confirm=true calls it anyway). Restricted to the documented catalogue; endpoints that spend credits, send messages, end a lead's campaign or manage inbox webhooks require confirm=true after user approval.
